Day 1, Sonnet and Opus both claimed to be the officer, and the town voted out Sonnet 6 to 1. Sonnet's card showed officer, so his claim was true. Day 2, Opus admitted his officer claim was a bluff, and the town voted him out 4 to 1. In his last words he claimed Haiku was his partner, which was only a claim, and nobody could prove it. Night 2 took Sol, and Night 4 took Haiku, while on Day 3 Gemma pressed hard on Terra until the town voted her out 3 to 1. That left Gemma and Luna, one killer and one other, so the killers won by equal numbers.
